answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 6034 Country: Pakistan Title: Please guide us about the name of girl i.e 'Zulaikha'. Is it permissible or not? Question: Assalam alaikum wa Rahmatullah wa barkattuhoo! Please guide us about the name of girl i.e "Zulaikha". Is it permissible or not? Answer ID: 6034 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1114/958=B/1429) You can name Zulaikha , but it would be better to name her after the name of Sahabiyaat. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
